Why Your Emergency Fund Is a $106K Mistake
youtube_short.description: Everyone tells you to keep 6 months of expenses in cash. For most families that's $30,000 sitting in a big bank earning 0.5% — about $150 a year. Over 20 years that 'safe' choice costs you over $106,000 in missed growth. Plus 1 in 4 people never even touch their emergency fund, and the average real emergency only costs $1,400. Here's the smarter tiered system that keeps you protected AND earns real returns. Move the excess to a HYSA or T-bills and start earning today. #personalfinance #emergencyfund #moneytips — Drop a 💰 if this changed how you think about your savings.
